verdicts.reason: Neither candidate really resizes the design. Both drop the original thin banner strip, unscaled, into the middle of a 16:9 canvas, leaving huge empty blue bands above and below. The 'DENTAL SERVICES' headline is tiny for the format, and the teeth end in hard, flat crop lines at the strip's old bottom edge. A is worse: it moves one cropped tooth down on its own, where its flat-cut bottom floats in empty space and looks clearly broken. B at least keeps the strip together, but it is still a shrunken copy of the original.
